_comment: AnythingLLM MCP server config. Copy this block into AnythingLLM's MCP servers file (Settings > Agent Skills > MCP Servers, or ~/AnythingLLM/plugins/anythingllm_mcp_servers.json). Adjust the two absolute paths for your machine, then restart the AnythingLLM agent.
_comment_pip: SANDBOX_PIP_INDEX_URL is what install_python_packages installs from. Leave it out and pip falls back to the public PyPI, which a closed network cannot reach, so every install fails. Add SANDBOX_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST (host name only) when the mirror is plain http -- without it pip silently ignores the index and reports the package as missing. Verify with: python check_environment.py
